data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/1450Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA BECOMES A REMNANT LOW PRESSURE AREA. As of 3:00 PM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.4, -43.6 with movement E at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 03/0239Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL CONTINUES WESTWARD AS IT PASSES SOCORRO ISLAND. ...SOME WEAKENING EXPECTED OVER NEXT SEVERAL DAYS... As of 8:00 PM MST Fri Oct 02 the center of Rachel was located near 19.4, -111.5 with movement W at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 966 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 100 mph.
